title: Hunyuan3D AI Generated Mesh to game ready (Texture Baking) My workflow
author: OpusGeo
selftext: Here I am demonstrating texture baking using [Simple Bake](https://superhivemarket.com/products/simplebake---simple-pbr-and-other-baking-in-blender-2) addon. Model was generated in [hunyuan3D 2.5](https://hunyuan3d.net/2-5/). I used decimate modifier in blender and show you the process.
